scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/wasm --target web --out-dir ../../packages/wasm/generated --out-name index --release && wasm-pack build crates/wasm --target nodejs --out-dir ../../packages/wasm/generated-node --out-name index --release && node scripts/prepare-wasm-package.mjs
scripts.build:packages: tsup packages/wasm/src/index.ts packages/wasm/src/node.ts --format esm --dts --out-dir packages/wasm/dist --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json --external ../generated/index.js --external ../generated-node/index.js && tsup packages/core/src/index.ts --format esm --dts --out-dir packages/core/dist --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json --external @universal-payment-qr/wasm && tsup packages/scanner/src/index.ts --format esm --dts --out-dir packages/scanner/dist --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json --external @zxing/browser && tsup packages/react/src/index.ts --format esm --dts --out-dir packages/react/dist --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json --external react --external @universal-payment-qr/core --external @universal-payment-qr/scanner && node scripts/distribute-packages.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run typecheck && npm run build:packages && vite build apps/playground
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build:packages && vite build apps/playground
